name: watch
description: Give an agent video evidence: timestamped frames and native captions, with optional local WhisperX or Groq/OpenAI transcription.

interface.shortDescription: Give your agent a video input — paste a URL or local path and ask about it.
interface.longDescription: watch gives an agent timestamped video frames and a transcript from native captions or an optional local WhisperX / cloud Whisper fallback. The agent views the selected frames and answers from the available visual and spoken evidence.
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
